findings.finding: RelMgr gates capture request through block-object virtual checks for factors 1, 0xf, 0x11 and 0x15; rejection emits type 5/0x4045 and admission emits type 2/0x3011 to 0x40193.
findings.method: LLVM control-flow inspection and prior static evidence

findings.finding: Local dispatcher admission reaches 0x43809ed8 only on specific return-value and message-byte guards, including msg+0xc == 4 at 0x43807e4e..0x43807e52; other branches clean up, notify, or return.
CaptureStart installer creates callback 0x437df640 and invokes 0x43b0172c(object,0); it has no direct Silent/EFCS/mechanical-mode branch.
CaptureStart dispatches classes 1, 2 and 3 separately; ordinary values call 0x437df338. Class 2 also reaches it when global+0x14 equals 1.
CaptureManager creates Image, selects a five-word descriptor, installs it, and executes its indirect stage dispatcher.
No static row-to-CAIF/Darwin mapping or flag selecting mechanical versus fully electronic capture was recovered; table contents are not available in the static image.
EFCS contributes to exposure-class selection, with additional mode, mask and threshold conditions.
findings.method: prior static route rechecked against selector evidence

findings.finding: EFCS exposure classes are not evidence of a fully electronic shutter or suppression of both curtains.
findings.method: absence of a recovered class-to-curtain bypass plus continued sensor programming
